integrity.classification_basis: Exact factorial quotients prove monotonicity toward the center; the k=2 Catalan edge and k=3 central-binomial domination then exhaust all parameters.

integrity.euler_basis: The standard Schubert decomposition has one affine cell per k-subset of an n-element set, giving binomial(n,k) Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0108133 lists version 1 on 2001-08-20.

scientific_limitations: The degree comparison is specific to the Plücker embedding.
The theorem compares numerical invariants and does not construct a direct map between generic linear-section points and Schubert cells.
The two input formulas are classical, so an older unindexed source may contain the same elementary threshold.
title: A sharp Plücker degree–Euler threshold for complex Grassmannians
